goal: Decide if a round of votes commits a block. A validator commits only when enough others agree, and only once it holds the block itself.

app.name: bft-commit
app.title: Quorum commit
app.purpose: Decide whether a round commits, waits, moves to the next round or fetches the block content, from the precommits seen, the quorum the validator set requires, whether the round timed out and whether the validator holds the referenced content.

fields.name: precommits
fields.means: precommit votes seen, by voting power

fields.name: quorum
fields.means: voting power a commit needs, more than two thirds

fields.name: timeout
fields.means: whether the round's precommit timeout fired

fields.name: payload
fields.means: whether the validator rebuilt the block from the referenced transactions

meanings.commit: the block is decided and finalized
meanings.wait: no quorum yet, the round continues
meanings.next: the round timed out without a quorum, the next round starts
meanings.fetch: a quorum decided a block whose content is missing: fetch it through the sync path, then commit

rules.why: implementation/README.md: anything missing is fetched through malachite's existing sync path, crates/sync
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: Tendermint-style rounds in malachite, more than two thirds of precommits decide the block
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 2: propose, prevote and precommit rounds, a timeout without a quorum starts the next round

app.otherwiseWhy: no quorum yet and time remains

properties.why: safety: no commit without a quorum
a block is committed only when its content can be rebuilt
a quorum on held content always commits

stakeholders.name: Validator
stakeholders.text: Runs a validator and needs a block committed only on a quorum, and always on one when it holds the content.

stakeholders.name: Chain operator
stakeholders.text: Grows the validator set and needs consensus to carry references while content arrives off the critical path.

concerns.name: Content before commit
concerns.text: A block proposed by reference is committed only once the validator holds its content, fetching anything missing through sync.

components.name: malachite
components.text: circlefin/malachite, the BFT consensus engine behind Arc that the repository's patch and benchmarks run against.

components.name: malachite sync
components.text: malachite's crates/sync, the fetch fallback for content a validator does not hold.

threats.name: Withheld payload
threats.text: A proposer sends references but withholds the transactions, so validators commit a block they cannot execute.

control.name: Fetch before commit
control.text: A quorum on missing content is answered fetch, never commit, proved for every request.

threats.name: Reference to other bytes
threats.text: A reference resolves to transactions other than those proposed.
threats.accepted: References are content addresses verified on receipt, BLAKE3 over canonical bytes per the UOR specification; the app sees only whether the content is held.

threats.name: Equivocating validators
threats.text: A third or more of the voting power signs conflicting precommits.
threats.accepted: BFT safety assumes less than a third of the voting power is faulty; the app counts the precommits it is given against the quorum.

quality.text: No round commits with precommits below the quorum, whatever the timeout or content.
quality.measureText: Requests with precommits below quorum answered commit.
